notes: Shifted the sound language from clean sci-fi UI toward guttural, digital and visceral cyberware hardware
Added low-frequency impact transients, distortion, compressed noise and sample-and-hold digital tearing
Hover is now an electrical tooth-click
Select is now a hard relay thunk with corrupted lock tone
Drawer is a low motor strain with physical latch
Scan is a dirty data scrape rather than a bright scanner chirp
Install is a heavy body-impact, machinery, handshake and seal sequence
Remove is a mechanical tear-away and decompression sound
Error now combines malfunction buzz with a low body hit
Confirm stays positive but uses a physical relay punch
Use FEHA_SOUNDS.visceralDemo() to audition the core set
